items.title: Committed live-readout report tool with hermetic selfcheck
items.context: Create experiments/experience-ablation/live-readout.mjs: CLI (node live-readout.mjs --root=<repoRoot> --experimentId=<id> [--out=<dir>]) that (1) spawns the existing read-only lattice learning_effectiveness (prefer a --json mode if the command supports it, else parse the stable text output defensively) for the live exploratory side; (2) reads score-records.jsonl, n-freeze.json, m7-decision.json from the experiment evidence root for the controlled side; (3) emits live-readout.json (machine) + live-readout.md (human) with two STRICTLY separated top-level sections — Controlled causal (pilot; includes the freeze refusal and the inconclusive verdict context) and Live exploratory (non-inferential; every figure labeled exploratory-only per plan sections 5.2/15) — plus the no-overclaim block. Deterministic given fixed inputs (no wall-clock in the payload; generatedAt accepted as input). Create live-readout-selfcheck.mjs (hermetic, temp roots, stub inputs): section separation asserted, exploratory labels present on every live figure, no-overclaim text present, deterministic double-run byte-identity, defensive failure on missing pilot artifacts with one-line actionable errors.
items.userSees: node experiments/experience-ablation/live-readout-selfcheck.mjs prints per-case PASS lines ending live-readout-selfcheck: all cases passed with exit 0

happy.desc: Selfcheck: report generated from stub inputs has the two strictly separated sections, exploratory-only labels on every live figure, and the no-overclaim block

edge.desc: Deterministic double-run byte-identity given fixed inputs; missing pilot artifacts fail with one-line actionable errors

adversarial.desc: No second live assignment system: the tool only reads the existing learning_effectiveness output and on-disk artifacts (no writes outside --out, no packages/main imports beyond the CLI spawn)

verificationEvidence.note: 26 PASS lines ending live-readout-selfcheck: all cases passed, exit 0, run twice. Section-separation case asserts controlled heading index < live heading index < no-overclaim; label case asserts all 11 live figure bullets carry [exploratory-only] and controlled section carries none; no-overclaim cases assert plan-15 disallowed claims (agents smarter / memory proves DONE / eliminates defects / generalizes) plus final verdict Causal impact: inconclusive - design assumption invalidated by the pilot baseline.

Determinism cases PASS: double run into two out dirs byte-identical for live-readout.json + live-readout.md; without --generatedAt payload records generatedAt:null and stays byte-identical across two runs (no wall clock in payload). Missing-artifact cases PASS: score-records.jsonl / n-freeze.json / m7-decision.json each missing -> exit 1 with exactly ONE stderr line prefixed live-readout: naming the artifact and the remediation; truncated score-records.jsonl and missing --effectivenessJson file also one-line actionable; missing flags exit 2 with usage.

No second live assignment system: live-readout.mjs imports only node:fs/node:path/node:child_process (zero packages/main imports; grep shows packages/main only inside the spawn path join(root,packages,main,dist,cli.js) and error hints). Write-boundary selfcheck case PASS: recursive sha256 tree digest of the stub root before/after a run (out dirs excluded) is identical, proving the tool writes only under --out. Selfcheck never spawns the real CLI (--effectivenessJson stub injection on every run).

items.title: Generate and persist the M8 report for expabl-m6-pilot-v1
items.context: Run the committed tool against the real evidence root: node experiments/experience-ablation/live-readout.mjs --root=<mainRepo> --experimentId=expabl-m6-pilot-v1 --out=<evidenceRoot>. Verify the emitted live-readout.md opens with the controlled-vs-exploratory separation, the live section carries the exploratory-only labels and the real learning_effectiveness figures, the controlled section carries the pilot summary (90 records, 0 voided, baseline 0.0333, freeze refused) and the m7-decision context, and live-readout.json parses with the same content. Persist both under the experiment evidence root (gitignored runtime evidence per plan section 12).
items.userSees: ls .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/expabl-m6-pilot-v1/ shows live-readout.json and live-readout.md, and head of live-readout.md shows the two separated sections with the exploratory-only labeling

happy.desc: Real report generated: live-readout.md opens with the controlled-vs-exploratory separation carrying real pilot figures (90 records, 0 voided, baseline 0.0333, freeze refused) and real learning_effectiveness figures

edge.desc: live-readout.json parses and mirrors the md content (machine/human consistency spot-check)

adversarial.desc: The live section carries exploratory-only/non-inferential labels and the m7-decision (skip_powered_study) context appears in the controlled section
